_comment: Long-form per-game data consumed by the about pages and by the JSON-LD generator in src/data/games.ts. Structured fields (genre, robloxGameId, etc.) mirror catalog data so a single source can populate both schema.org markup and the LLM-facing /llms.txt without re-reading the engineering catalog. Fields are intentionally optional on the consumer side; missing values are dropped from schema output.

media.caption: Low quality picture of a low quality game

body: the town is overrun. the Furries took it. the contractors are us, the people the town hired because nobody who actually lives there can do the job anymore.

you start at Whiskerhold. that's the only ground that's still yours. Furward, Furrow, Purridge, Whisken, Bloodwhisk Reach, and Whiskspire start in Furry hands. a flag isn't yours because you walked up to it. it's yours when you've held it long enough for the town to accept the change.

Furries aren't one creature with different health bars. some chase. some hold flags. some shoot from range. some are still a problem after they die. the pressure scales with the lobby, so cleared streets don't stay clear.

three modes. Traditional is the full job, 48 minutes, take the six and then go open the door under the town. Rush is 7:30 on a single flag at Furrow. Infection is 15 minutes and downed contractors come back on the wrong side.
guns, vehicles, helicopters. enough to make a mess. none of it makes the landing zone safe.
take the six in Traditional and the route opens under the town. through the basement of a random house, down a tunnel, there's a large unnamed man and a lot of small Furries.
features: seven territories. one of them is yours when the round starts. the other six aren't.
eight kinds of Furry. some chase, some explode, some sit at range, one's just a Watcher with pink spheres on his head.
three modes. Traditional is 48 minutes and ends at the boss. Rush is 7:30 on one flag. Infection ruins your day for 15.
guns, vehicles, helicopters. ATVs, Humvees, JLTVs, a Blackhawk, the occasional T-34. some of them work.
take the six in Traditional and a tunnel opens up. there's a large unnamed man at the end of it.
